verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a documentation platform, but no first-party evidence describes a way to self-host the current GitBook product. The docs present it as a hosted SaaS with custom domains, and community reports say GitBook moved everything to its SaaS and stopped active development of the old open-source CLI. An older remark that 'most of the product is open-source' describes the legacy tool, not a supported self-hosting option for the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
